title: Explicit live trading authorization and safe reduction exemptions

commits.note: WP-01 and WP-02 share one commit because the typed sink context is the seam both need; splitting it would have produced a commit that cannot pass its own tests.

baseline.head: 43e1ce2c0308e4df341bc8232d402f096cbf53ee
baseline.command: uv run --frozen pytest tests/unit/test_live_gate_enforcement.py tests/unit/test_live_hot_stop_coverage.py tests/unit/test_app_cli_contract.py tests/unit/test_app_demo.py -q

implementation: _cmd_run refuses live/shadow_live auto-trade before the stop, scanner and clients
payload guard in BitunixFuturesClient.place_order and flash_close_position
proven_reduction_shapes: futures place_order: tradeSide=CLOSE + reduceOnly=true + matching one-way position + closing side + 0 < qty <= position.qty
flash_close_position: observable, fresh, non-zero position; payload is {positionId} only
unknown_shapes: no position, zero position, excess quantity, wrong side, hedge/ambiguous mode, stale snapshot, unreadable position
